description: Legacy LaTeX template for ACM SIGCHI Extended Abstract articles, retained for authors working on legacy documents after ACM's retirement of the format in favor of sigconf. Provides a landscape-orientation two-column layout with a wide left margin, sidebar/marginfigure/margintable environments for marginal content, CCS-concepts and keywords sections, teaser figures, and numeric or author-year citations via natbib, based on the acmart document class with the sigchi-a and nonacm options.
